description_en: Queries information about assets that do not have the client installed
description_zh: 查询未安装客户端的资产信息
kebab_example: aliyun sas list-uninstall-aegis-machines --source-ip 180.113.XX.XX --page-size 5 --current-page 4 --region-no cn-hangzhou --os linux --remark 172.20.XX.XX --vendor 0 --region-id-str cn-hangzhou --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListUninstallAegisMachines

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the access source
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Default value: 5, which indicates that 5 entries are displayed per page
parameters.help_zh: 设置分页查询时，每页显示的备份文件的数量。默认值为5，表示每页显示5条备份文件
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number of the first page to display in the query results. Default value: 1, which indicates that the query results are displayed from page 1
parameters.help_zh: 设置从返回结果的第几页开始显示查询结果。默认值为1，表示从第1页开始显示
parameters.name: current_page
